data.exact_reserve_text: As at 31 December 2020, Syndicate 1110 is declaring a profit of GBP 5.9m (2019: loss of GBP 0.2m) of which GBP 7.9m is attributable to 2020 year of account, partially offset by losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net adverse prior-year result of GBP 2.0m (strengthening of reserves), attributed to losses on the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account. The report also describes material portfolio transactions during 2020 (LPTs and an ADC) which increased gross written premium and technical provisions and have materially affected the reserve position for the 2020 year of account.
raw_causal_phrases: partially offset by losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively.
This transaction has resulted in an increase to Syndicate 1110's gross written premium of GBP 95.2m and an increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 82.2m.
This transaction has strengthened the reserve position of the 2020 year of account by GBP 14.8m.
A provision has been made for unallocated loss adjusted expenses (ULAE) of GBP 5,389k

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross movement by line is not presented in a dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision' note. The PYD figure reported here (+/-GBP 2.0m) is derived from the year-of-account result breakdown sentence (members' attribution) rather than an explicit gross prior-year movement table. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found. A gross claims development triangle is present but the table text is fragmented in the source and may be affected by RITC/LPT transactions (which can distort development patterns). Accordingly the PYD figure should be treated as derived from member/result attribution and not a direct gross reserve movement reconciliation; if a strict gross movements note is required it was not located.
